criteria.requirement: Repair trusted-local pickle roundtrips for Box subclasses: root, direct/deep mapping children and mappings inside BoxList must preserve their actual classes and configuration for protocols 2 through the highest supported protocol. Preserve values, existing shared references, custom instance state, default_box/conversion_box/frozen_box options and frozen mutation guards. Restore configuration before replaying items, do not rerun business __init__, globally register pickle hooks or change normal construction and YAML/JSON conversion. Ordinary Box and BoxList must retain frozen upstream behavior.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
